title: Fat-md-growth pre-check before commit-only dispatch
desc: Before dispatching a mechanical commit-only sector for a growth-gated markdown letter, diff working copy vs HEAD first
steps: Run wc -c on the working file and git show HEAD:<file> piped to wc -c BEFORE dispatching a commit-only Haiku sector for HANDOFF.md or any fat-md-growth-guarded file
If the working copy is larger than HEAD, shrink it first (archive an old section to a sidecar, or extract prose into a skill) -- do not dispatch a commit attempt that will predictably be refused

Measured 2026-09-09 in WKAppBot: a commit-only dispatch was correctly scoped and mechanically sound, but was refused by fat-md-growth because the letter had grown 8618 bytes since HEAD -- a single wc -c comparison before dispatch would have caught this
author: claude
